class_guess: Bouncer + Chaotic Edge: translating period-10 bouncer feeding a 1-sided chaotic edge map
summary: Clean period-10 bouncer; every 7 bounces a fixed probe stirs a ~144-564-cell chaotic tail D. Tail = the whole problem.
mechanism: Bulk (1101101101)^a sits on a left wall; each bounce shifts it 1 cell left (70a steps).
A fixed 54-cell junction cycles through 7 shapes; the bulk gains 1 block per 7 bounces.
Only every 7th bounce enters the tail D (the same 16 round trips = 32 crossings, one cell left of the cut, each time). D stays 144-564 cells, content chaotic.

template.diff: 8 transitions apart under best relabel (A0 A1 B0 B1 C0 C1 E0 F1): class template, not a neighbour
template.note: Shape carries over: left wall (sideRLs_wall) + whole tape as right side + k-bounce BigStep (ours k=7, theirs 128). Its RInc native check needs a periodic edge; our D never repeats (5500000 cycles), so D needs a closed-language lemma.

strategy: Longitudinal split as in Bouncer_v3/LongNv1: wall + bulk sweeps by ind (12n, 58n) + 7 fixed junction bounces reduce nonhalt to the 1-sided edge map D -> P(D) with a fixed 16-round-trip (32-crossing) input one cell left of the cut (sideRLs list). Then find a closed regular language for D outside Rocq (CTL/FAR-style automaton on the edge map) and check it in Rocq verified-checker style (Fixpoint + soundness + vm_compute).
risks: No small closed language for D may exist (FAR failed on the full machine; the SFT {000,0101,01101111} is not closed).
Proving P independent of a and the junction lemmas needs segRLs/sideRLs plumbing (LongN/InfiniteRect style, 15-30 KB).
|D| bounded only empirically (144-564); a very long transient could still end in 001 C> 0.

Fig 2: does the noisy band at the right end keep about the same width all the way down, rather than widening?
Fig 3: is the left side a smooth curve, with only the right edge ragged?

stats.growth: both edges ~sqrt(t) (lo -0.44sqrt t, hi +0.21sqrt t); edge map 5500000 cycles ~ 7.4e+15 steps, |D| 144-564

status_reason: Mechanism found and validated (bulk, junction, probe); tail D is chaotic but bounded, not arithmetic (no Collatz-like growth), so not a cryptid. Next: closed language for the edge map.
